learning_need: Current European digital-regulation specialist training accessible in European Portuguese
decision_rationale: Regulação Digital is compact at eight hours, but it clears the canonical bar because it serves a distinct current cross-regulatory need that the existing HELP courses do not duplicate. The ten-module route connects European digital-regulation foundations with platforms and markets, data, AI/emerging technology, content moderation, e-commerce, digital accessibility and compliance implementation. At 8.48 Quality / 8.8 Recommendation it is not a token language slot: its intrinsic quality is comparable to existing specialist legal admissions, while full pt-PT instruction materially improves access for Portuguese-speaking professionals. The HELP courses remain stronger in their narrower privacy and AI-human-rights roles.
marginal_value: Adds the first current broad digital-regulation specialist in pt-PT, complementing rather than replacing the stronger narrow European-law incumbents.
provider_concentration_notes: ARTE / Academia Portugal Digital is not concentrated in the canonical Law & Public Policy set; provider identity is not a limiting factor.
coverage_notes: Materially improves current pt-PT legal/regulatory coverage without pretending to provide a complete general-law curriculum.

learning_need: Portuguese organisational cybersecurity governance, risk, incident-management and legal-compliance training
decision_rationale: Responsável de Cibersegurança earns admission as a distinct governance/compliance route, not as a replacement for Cisco's lab-rich threat-management course. Its 15-hour ten-module pathway covers the current Portuguese/EU legal framework, risk management, organisational controls, audit, asset inventory, incident management, policy, planning and compliance reporting. At 8.78 Quality / 9.0 Recommendation it is intrinsically strong, and its direct alignment with Portugal's new 2025/2026 cybersecurity regime creates exceptional current professional value. Portuguese-language access adds meaningful marginal value without a quality sacrifice.
marginal_value: Adds a current pt-PT route for the organisational cybersecurity-responsible role, a need not served by the English technical and cybercrime-law incumbents.
provider_concentration_notes: CNCS appears in more than one new candidate, but this course serves an operational governance/compliance role distinct from the executive NIS2 route. Both independently clear the quality bar.
coverage_notes: Closes a major pt-PT cybersecurity-governance gap while preserving Cisco as the stronger lab-heavy technical governance recommendation.

learning_need: Executive cybersecurity governance and NIS2 readiness in European Portuguese
decision_rationale: The 30-hour NIS2 course clears the admission bar on both intrinsic quality and distinct learner role. It is designed for executives and organisational leaders rather than security operators, and covers NIS/NIS2, incident response and business continuity, supply-chain security, secure acquisition/development/maintenance, vulnerability analysis, cryptography, access control/MFA and cyber-hygiene. At 8.81 Quality / 9.1 Recommendation it is one of the strongest pt-PT courses in the index. Its overlap with Responsável de Cibersegurança is acceptable because one trains an operational responsibility function and this one trains governance and leadership decision-making.
marginal_value: Adds a rare substantial pt-PT executive cybersecurity pathway aligned with the current Portuguese/EU regulatory environment.
provider_concentration_notes: CNCS concentration is accepted because the two admitted courses serve clearly distinct organisational roles and both are current, substantive and separately useful.
coverage_notes: Creates a current executive NIS2/governance route while leaving offensive security and hands-on technical defense to existing canonical courses.
